Berserker.name: Reckless
Berserker.description: Any Melee Attacks you make until the end of the Phase gain Boon(1), but all Attacks against you have Boon(1) until the end of the next Enemy Phase.

Berserker.name: No Time To Whimper
Berserker.description: Whenever you take a Wound, you may immediately Retaliate against the target that inflicted it.

Berserker.name: High Stakes
Berserker.description: Gain an amount of Boon equal to the number of Wounds you have on the next roll.

Bladeslinger.name: Swift Strike
Bladeslinger.description: Take the Move Action, paying its cost as normal. You may make an Attack with a Light weapon from your starting location.

Bladeslinger.name: Return
Bladeslinger.description: At the end of the current Phase the Weapon returns to your hand, dealing 1 damage to each unit it passes through on its way back.

Bladeslinger.name: Opportunist
Bladeslinger.description: If Return causes a creature to be hit by 3 or more weapons at once, you may immediately make a free Attack against them.

Climber.name: Strong Fingers
Climber.description: You gain Boon(1) on checks to Climb and hold onto objects.

Climber.name: Cat Fall
Climber.description: As a Reaction when you fall, you may roll your Agility die and reduce the fall damage by the number rolled.

Climber.name: Wall Run
Climber.description: On a successful Climb check, you may move your full Speed along the surface.

Commander.name: Charge!
Commander.description: Designate a point on the battlefield. Command an ally to Move towards that point for free, without proviking Retaliations.

Commander.name: Hold!
Commander.description: Designate an ally. Any Attack Actions made against the ally until the start of their next Phase will have Bane(1). You can now spend additional AP to have your Commander Abilities affect more allies, with a max total AP limit of 2. Each ally must receive the same exact command.

Commander.name: Strike!
Commander.description: Designate a target. Command an ally to take a 1 AP Attack Action against the target for free. You can now spend additional AP to have your Commander Abilities affect more allies, with a max total AP limit equal to your Presence Mod (minimum of 2). Each ally must receive the same exact command.

Gambler.name: Double Down
Gambler.description: After you make a roll, but before the result is revealed, you may Double Down, rolling again with a chance of turning failure into success. If this roll fails the consequences are doubled, and you can not Double Down again on the same Action.

Gambler.name: Calculated Risk
Gambler.description: When targeted by an attack, you may leave yourself open, giving the attacker Boon(1) on the attack. In return, the attacker is left open, granting all attacks against it Boon(1) until its next Phase.

Gambler.name: Critical Point
Gambler.description: Whenever you land a Heavy Hit or higher, you may choose to roll for Damage instead of using the normal damage system. The die used for this roll is equal to the size of a #boon(Weapon damage + Successes - 1) die.

Dirty Fighter.name: Hobble
Dirty Fighter.description:
Your next Attack slices an exposed tendon or muscle on hit, inflicting either condition until the end of their next Turn:
- The target's Speed is halved
- The target has Bane(1) on its next Attack.

Dirty Fighter.name: Cripple
Dirty Fighter.description:
Hobble gains these additional options:
- The Damage of the target's next hit is reduced by 1
- The target is Blinded

Dirty Fighter.name: Pay Day
Dirty Fighter.description: You make a precise strike powerful enough to shock all Debuffs currently on the target out of them on hit. For each unique debuff removed, this Attack deals 1 extra Damage.

Duelist.name: Fleet Footwork
Duelist.description: While neither you nor the target is adjacent to any other creatures, your movement does not provoke Retaliations from the target.

Duelist.name: Fencer
Duelist.description: Before or after making your next Attack Roll, you may Step 1 Space. If you move directly towards the target, gain Boon(1) on the Attack Roll. If you move away from the target, prepare to counter, allowing you to Retaliate the next time someone moves into your Threat.

Duelist.name: Flexible Counter
Duelist.description: When you take the Counter Retaliation, you may choose to Enhance the Retaliation with any compatible Attack Enhancement, paying its cost as normal.

Tank Buster.name: Crusher
Tank Buster.description: Whenever you deal damage to Guard with a compatible Weapon, deal 1 extra Damage

Tank Buster.name: Guard Breaker
Tank Buster.description: When you break a target's Guard, you may immediately make a free Attack against them.

Tank Buster.name: Can Opener
Tank Buster.description: When you land a Brutal Hit on a target, you reduce their #term[Block] by 1. #term[Block] reduced this way can be restored at a rate of 1 Block for 1 #(Rest Point, key: Rest Points)

Corruptor.name: Degraded Focus
Corruptor.description: When you're about to spend Focus, you may choose to instead Saturate the same amount of Focus.

Corruptor.name: Empowered Focus
Corruptor.description: Whenever you spend Corrupted Focus as part of an Action, you gain Boon on the Action equal to the amount of Corrupted Focus spent.

Corruptor.name: Controlled Corruption
Corruptor.description: When you fail a Saturation Roll, you only Corrupt half the amount of Focus you normally would. This does not affect the tier of the gained Mutation.

Oracle.name: Prescient Planner
Oracle.description: You may spend Scrap while in the field to have retroactively purchased something useful. This ability is useable an amount of times equal to your Presence mod per Hunt.

Oracle.name: Far Seer
Oracle.description: You're able to cast your vision over long distances. Roll your Presence die, and choose a hex within a number of steps of the number rolled. You learn the Hex's terrain type as well as either the Hex's location or highest threat creature.

Oracle.name: Pathfinder
Oracle.description: You can augur the shortest path to any location you've seen. Choose any Hex you're familiar with, learning the shortest path there. While on this path, you don't need to make Navigation checks.

Protector.name: Protectlier
Protector.description: When you take the Protect Reaction, you may take the entire chunk of damage, instead of splitting it with the ally you're protecting.

Protector.name: Valiant Aid
Protector.description: You may use the Protect Reaction on allies within your Speed, moving to a space adjacent to them.

Protector.name: Not Even a Scratch
Protector.description: When you take the Protect Reaction, you gain 1 Block to the triggering Attack.

Polearm Fisher.name: Hook
Polearm Fisher.description: Your next Melee Attack pulls the target adjacent to you if it's smaller than you, or pull yourself adjacent to it if it's larger than you. If you're the same size, you choose.

Polearm Fisher.name: Line
Polearm Fisher.description: When you Hook a target at the tip of your Weapon's Reach, the target is Slowed(Successes).

Polearm Fisher.name: Sinker
Polearm Fisher.description: When you hit a target who is #term[Slowed], you may knock them #[Prone]

Pusher.name: Forceful
Pusher.description: When you hit with an Attack, you may use up to 3 Focus to Push the targets that many Spaces.

Pusher.name: Cleave
Pusher.description: Your next Attack hits three connecting spaces within the weapon's range, using the same Attack Roll for each target.

Pusher.name: Batter
Pusher.description: Units taking Knockback within your Threat trigger your Attack of Opportunity. When you Retaliate with this feature, you may add +1 Knockback to the target and redirect the remaining Knockback on the target.

Rusher.name: Surprise!
Rusher.description: When Rushing, gain Boon(1) on your first Action Roll

Rusher.name: Fleet-footed
Rusher.description: When Rushing, gain +2 Speed for your first Move

Rusher.name: Keep moving
Rusher.description: After Rushing, you may take one 0 AP Action during the Methodical Phase.

Tactician.name: Quick Thinking
Tactician.description: Take an Action outside your chosen Phase, paying the normal cost of the Action in addition to the Focus spent on this Ability.

Tactician.name: Tactical Mind
Tactician.description: When you choose to go Methodical, gain 4 AP instead of 3.

Tactician.name: Creative Accounting
Tactician.description: Gain 1 additional AP for this Round, but gain 1 less AP for the next Round. Cannot be used two rounds in a row.

Tank.name: Tough as Nails
Tank.description: While wearing Armor your Heavy and Brutal Hit thresholds are increased by 1.

Tank.name: Steady as a Rock
Tank.description:
While wearing Armor you gain the following benefits:
- +1 Stability
- You may, as a Reaction to an ally taking Knockback that sends them past you, cancel the Knockback at any point within your Reach.

Tank.name: Protector
Tank.description: Enemies have Bane(1) to attack allies within your Reach.

Team Player.name: Back to back
Team Player.description: While adjacent to an ally, neither you nor they can be flanked.

Team Player.name: None Left Behind
Team Player.description: You count as Adjacent to Allies within 2 Spaces for the sake of your own Abilities that rquire adjacency.

Team Player.name: Tag Team Tycoon
Team Player.description: Once per day, you may initiate an extra Tag Team with any adjacent allies.

Versatile Fighter.name: Adaptable
Versatile Fighter.description: Until the end of the Scene or you use this Ability again, you treat all compatible Weapons you're wielding as having one of the following tags, provided the weapon is not already tagged with it: Reach(2), Crush(1), Thrown(5)

Versatile Fighter.name: Soft Reset
Versatile Fighter.description: When you make an #term(Attack, key: Attacks) you may end the active Adaptable effect early, retaining the bonus for this #term(Attack, key: Attacks) and granting #boon[1] to it. In addition, you gain the following new options for Adaptable: Intercept(2), Impact(1)

Versatile Fighter.name: Two for One
Versatile Fighter.description: You may have two Adaptable effects active at once. In addition, you gain the following new options for Adaptable: Crush(2), Sharp(1)

Unused Stuff.description: At the start of each Round in combat, you may designate 1 ally, moving them to the Rushed Phase without spending AP.

Unused Stuff.name: Random Bullshit Go!
Unused Stuff.description: You may treat all Light weapons as if they have Thrown(5). If the weapon already has Thrown, its range increases by 3.

Unused Stuff.name: Greater Counter
Unused Stuff.description: If you're granted the opportunity to Retaliate in response to an Attack made against you, you may Retaliate twice, choosing two different options.
